stem.en: Which part of the Cell Theory did Rudolf Virchow add in 1855?

text.en: All plants are made up of cells.
All animals are made up of cells.
New cells form only from pre-existing cells.

feedback.en: Yes. This is the third statement of the theory.

text.en: Living things have tiny box-like rooms inside them.

feedback.en: Hooke described box-like structures in cork in 1665.

explanation.en: Virchow stated that new cells are formed only from pre-existing cells.

hints.en: Which statement is about where cells come from?
